## About Me

I am currently pursuing a Bachelor of Science in Business Administration with an emphasis in Marketing Management at California State Polytechnic University, Pomona. My academic experience has allowed me to build skills in marketing analytics, digital marketing, data visualization, business strategy, and web development using Quarto. Through coursework and projects, I have gained experience analyzing data, creating dashboards, and presenting insights to support data-driven decision-making.
